summary: Backend + UI test of the new slot-locking feature on invites and date-bookings. 13/13 backend pytest cases pass; UI shows free-only ranges on profile availability and locked-time list inside InviteDateModal exactly as specified.
action_items: Cleanup orphan imports: DateBookingModal is imported in /app/frontend/src/pages/Browse.jsx and /app/frontend/src/pages/ProfileView.jsx but never rendered (dead import). ProfileView only mounts InviteDateModal when the user clicks 'Invite on a Date' or a day in the availability overview. If 'Book a Date' is still intended to be a separate flow (as the spec mentions DateBookingModal with testid date-time), it needs a UI entry point; otherwise remove the imports.
critical_code_review_comments: _taken_blocks dedupes identical blocks via tuple(sorted(x.items())) — works today but relies on dict value equality; if lock_from/lock_to drift by any computation path it could silently keep duplicates. Consider dedupe by (reason, from, to).

_assert_slot_free compares start_min against lock bounds but when a cancelled window wraps midnight (lock_to <= lock_from) it extends lt by 1440; however start_min for the new date is never wrapped, so a block like 22:45-01:00 would correctly reject a 00:00 start only because 00:00 falls into [-...] mod. The existing invite windows at 22:00 and 23:00 on 2026-10-16 produce lock_to crossing midnight and the test confirmed SLOT_BUSY works. Good.
profile_availability returns busy_slots AND locked_days — slightly redundant payload (locked_days is a subset of busy_slots filtered by reason=='cancelled'); fine for UI but keep in mind.
DateBookingModal.jsx is orphan (not wired to any trigger). If kept, add a UI entry or delete to avoid bitrot.

context_for_next_testing_agent:
Backend verified end-to-end:
- GET /api/profiles/{pid}/availability returns busy_slots per local day with keys from/to/lock_from/lock_to/reason. 15-min buffer confirmed (19:00-21:30 -> lock_from 18:45, lock_to 21:45).
- locked_days contains only cancelled blocks (not fully-booked days).
- POST /api/invites and POST /api/dates/book both raise TIME_PASSED (past-day on an open weekly schedule), SLOT_LOCKED:19:00-21:30 (overlap cancelled on 2026-10-24) and SLOT_BUSY:... (overlap pending invite on 2026-10-16).
- Valid 2026-10-24 00:00 invite succeeds (status INVITATION_SENT), persisted with local_day/local_time via /api/invites listing.

Frontend verified on /profile/fc5b1d5f-3966-428d-b13c-04911f9f38f3 as Bob:
- profile-availability card lists ONLY free ranges (no 'Booked'/'Cancelled' tags).
- 2026-10-16 (fully-blocked) absent from the open-day list; 2026-10-24 shows only 00:00–03:00 (3 start times).
- Clicking profile-avail-day-2026-10-24 opens InviteDateModal with Sat Oct 24 selected on the calendar; invite-time clock defaults 00:00, Date starts 00:00 / ends 02:30.
- invite-time-locked lists '19:00–21:30 · cancelled date' (testid invite-time-locked-19:00 present); Available hours chip = 00:00–03:00; Quick picks = 00:00–02:30.
- Only 00 hour is active on the clock; 19..21 hours fall outside the window and are correctly excluded from starts.

Not verified via UI: DateBookingModal (date-time testid). The component is imported but never rendered anywhere in the app, so there is no UI trigger for it. If the 'Book a Date' flow is still a product requirement, main agent needs to wire a trigger button. The underlying code path uses the same TimeChooser so behavior would be identical to InviteDateModal.
